# Thrift fixtures

`gold.json` is generated by `generate.py` and read by
`test/encoding/Thrift.test.ts`. Each case is a value tree and the bytes the
official Apache Thrift Python library (`thrift` 0.25.0 from PyPI,
`TCompactProtocol`) writes for it: one hand-written case per rule of the
compact protocol, then 20 small seeded random structs.

The `parquet` section holds compact-protocol structs cut from two files of
[apache/parquet-testing](https://github.com/apache/parquet-testing) (commit
`bcefdfd`): the `FileMetaData` footers of `data_index_bloom_encoding_stats.parquet`
and `alltypes_tiny_pages.parquet`, a page header from each, and the bloom
filter header, offset index and column index of the first. Each comes with the
tree the Python reader reads from it. The row counts, column names and
offsets the test checks are the ones pyarrow reports for those files.

Regenerate from `packages/effect`; the output is byte for byte the same:

```sh
PARQUET_TESTING=/path/to/parquet-testing \
  uv run --with thrift==0.25.0 python test/fixtures/thrift/generate.py
```

`PARQUET_TESTING` needs only the two files above, under `data/`.
